subject.title: fix(channels): scope wizard credentials to the selected account

question: Should the generic wizard adapter own temporary `defaultAccount` scoping and root-credential promotion for all legacy accounts-schema channel plugins?
rationale: This fixes a serious cross-plugin corruption class, but it intentionally changes compatibility behavior for every legacy plugin that resolves credentials through the default account; the permanent owner boundary and upgrade semantics need maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Accept the generic adapter boundary
options.body: Confirm the shared adapter is the intended compatibility owner after reviewing the promotion-key contract and real multi-account proof.

options.title: Narrow the repair to an explicit plugin contract
options.body: Require affected plugins to adopt an account-aware setup callback or a declared compatibility hook instead of relying on generic credential-key promotion.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic adapter boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm the shared adapter is the intended compatibility owner after reviewing the promotion-key contract and real multi-account proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the author of the scoped shared-adapter repair; stronger historical ownership could not be established from the read-only environment.
